# `CheckPhotoMetry`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

State of the photometry check stage, with the solved coordinate at completion.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, CheckPhotoMetryFunc @0x1fd5f0, PrintCheckPhotoMetry @0x1fa810, PrintFuncState @0x6e2100 (64-bit build) |

The view stage started by check_photometry runs CheckPhotoMetryFunc as a named function before capture. Function-state family (SendFuncEvent): state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. Its formatter adds ra_dec_deg_j2000 only in complete; it is not present while working. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence. The RPC reference leaves the Event-name binding unresolved; the events audit reads it.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"CheckPhotoMetry"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function-state name. idle is an initial/restored state and is not automatically sent; unknown internal codes fall back to idle. A formatter supporting a state does not mean every run visits it. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or any state with a start and no end time, including complete) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail (function producer) | - | At fail, even if 0. Worker codes named by the RPC reference: 238 exposure failed, 251 solve failed, 204 out of image, 253 aborted, 300 conversion error. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |
| `ra_dec_deg_j2000` | array<number> | if state complete only | - | Cached coordinate pair (RA, Dec). RA is stored as hours times 15 (READ); degrees and J2000 are INFERRED from the key name and that conversion. No validity test after the state check. Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |
| `has_download_ref_star` | boolean | if state complete (same check as ra_dec_deg_j2000; firmware 9.75) | - | Firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0: written next to ra_dec_deg_j2000 at the same state check (printed as a raw true or false) and reporting a stored flag, most likely whether the reference stars were downloaded (meaning INFERRED from the name). The condition that sets it was not traced. Absent in firmware 9.31. [READ (existence, place); meaning INFERRED] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, complete - Completion (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"CheckPhotoMetry","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","lapse_ms":9100,"ra_dec_deg_j2000":[120.5,20.25],"route":["View","CheckPhotoMetry"]}
```

Event, fail - Solve failure (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"CheckPhotoMetry","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","lapse_ms":4000,"code":251,"error":"solve failed"}
```
